said.text: Improving access to childcare means expanding funding and modernizing outdated administrative processes that hold back the ability to provide families with affordable, trustworthy care. This bill will streamline processes on the government side and make finding childcare a little easier while maintaining every safeguard that keeps our kids safe.

did.text: Voted Yes on Int 0015-2026, setting requirements and reporting for background checks for child care providers, employees, and volunteers. Passed 51–0.

whyNote: Majority Leader Abreu's statement in the Council's release is associated with Int 15-A, the background-check bill the vote passed; he voted yes the same day.
